name: standard
description: Two simulated days on the full Purdue industrial site with the shift day profile: a 24 h learning day, a 12 h window with six IT and OT intrusions at fixed offsets, then the 12 h baseline-then-change campaign. Meant for a live run with --speed (60 = 48 min on the wire) or a long synthetic capture.

stages.description: a full working day of normal operation for the monitor to learn
ransomware, ICS reconnaissance, a PLC STOP, an IEC 104 command storm, a safety-system program download and SMB lateral movement
